_comment: THE canonical feature list. Every user-visible capability of Ergopti+ has
exactly one name here, and every driver either implements it under that name
or does not implement it at all — never under a second spelling.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the list lived in prose in TODO.md, so nothing could
read it. Invariant I1 ('one tree') and Convention S ('the stub with a
reason') both need a machine-readable canonical list, and without one the
tree-parity gate could only compare the drivers to EACH OTHER — which says
nothing about a feature none of them has, and cannot tell a deliberate
THE `tree` FIELD IS NOT DECORATION, and writing this file is what made that
clear. The prose list said every named feature is `modules/<name>/`. The tree
disagrees, and the tree is right: a feature the user OPERATES lives in
modules/ (gestures, llm, shortcuts), while a feature the user LOOKS AT is a
window and lives in ui/ (action_picker, changelog, model_browser). Ten of the
25 are windows. Forcing them into modules/ would have been a rename in
HOW TO USE IT: test-driver-tree-parity.cjs reads it and ratchets how many
canonical features are present on all three drivers. Add a feature here when
it gains a name a user could say out loud, not when a folder appears.

features.name: action_picker
features.role: picker window for gesture and chord actions

features.name: diagnostics
features.role: crash reporting and the diagnostic dump

features.name: download
features.role: asset and model downloads with progress

features.name: gestures
features.role: trackpad gesture slots and their actions

features.name: healthcheck
features.role: the health window and its probes

features.name: layout
features.role: the physical keyboard layout and its install

features.name: paths
features.role: resolution of every user file location

features.name: personal_info
features.role: the user's own data for dynamic expansions

features.name: shortcuts
features.role: chords, text transforms and their bindings

_absent_everywhere: apps, download, hotstrings_config, layout, metrics and personal_info have no
folder under their canonical name on ANY driver — the capability exists (app
profiles are read, models are downloaded, hotstring groups are toggled, the
layout is installed, personal info expands) but each is spread through
another module. They are the six that Convention S cannot stub, because
there is nothing to stub AROUND yet: the work is extraction, not a README.
